Nothing has ever worked for me and I’ve tried it all being 41. I have never repurchased any other eye product. This is gentle and hydrating, yet very effective. Freshness matters. Buy the small size. I learned this tip from another review: put on a few times while getting ready in the morning and before bed at night, letting the layers fully absorb (absorption takes a bit longer than you’d expect for a gel cream). When the cream is fresh, it ABSOLUTELY makes puffiness go down. It will last all through the night so you wake up fresh eyed, and all day, when you generously pack it on a few times each morning & evening. Bonus: you’ll use it up and replace faster so it will always be fresh product. I’ve never NOT had puffy lids and under eyes upon waking in 10 years til I did this. It feels cooling (rich doesn’t). Also using this OR the rich work on dark circles (though rich not effective on puffiness and too greasy for my combo oily skin). They “bleached” very noticeable flesh colored goggles onto my entire discolored red/blue orbital area. They also both made double rows of top lashes grow. The color correction and lash growth is from long-term use; puffiness is instant (remember: the cream MUST be fresh and non-rich for it to work on puffiness). Doesn’t cause milia. Makes no “anti aging” claims, only retinoids do that. This actually does what it advertises.

review_text: Alcohol Denat is the fifth ingredient. This ingredient is terrible for your skin. Bad alcohols (such as alcohol denat) when used in high concentrations in skincare deteriorate your skin’s protective barrier which means your skin is no longer effective at keeping moisture in. It also stimulates oil production which could lead to breakouts if your skin makes too much oil. Although alcohol denat makes the cream feel lighter and dries down more quickly, it’s not worth those pros, at all. Also, this comes in a jar packaging. I still don’t understand why companies do this - not only is it significantly less sanitary, any beneficial ingredients degrade significantly more quickly in a jar so you’re paying for nothing.

review_text: Love the scent, and the clean off even stubborn waterproof makeup with ease.  Only drawback, I wish they were a little bigger,  I frequently have to use 2 to clean my face completely.

This is an okay balm (I’ve purchased it twice now.). It’s more moisturizing and slightly oily, so it will be great for restoring moisture but requires reapplication. I don’t mind the price because it’s wide, so it really does last forever. (I’m currently on my second month of use, and I use it daily but alternate between this and Burt’s). The number one reason that I buy this is the scent. It is truly amazing, and it is honestly the reason why I’ll spend the $18. The creamy, warm, sweetness is a 5-star smell.

I bought this after using the mini size for a bit.  Really great stuff.  Doesn’t irritate my eyes.  

I was using coconut oil for a while, but it didn’t get all of my eye make up off.  This does! It’s especially good for heavy mascara.  Product lasts a long time as well.
product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

review_text: Love this serum, moisturize my skin good. Definitely will get the full size.

I was super excited for this product because I love the tatcha deep cleansing one, and the ingredients are clean. I also love their rice polishing powder so I was expecting good things. It has a really nice smooth lather and great texture and doesn’t leave your skin feeling stripped or dry. Unfortunately, it gave me types of pimples I’ve never had before (like oily, it was weird) in places I’ve never had breakouts before. I have combo skin.

I think the product is great for a makeup removal but there are more affordable solutions. I wouldn’t recommend it or promote it as something that will help your acne either. I’m always on a quest for perfect skin and became fascinated with the Korean skincare routine and started implementing those methods in my routine. I spent a year doing the double cleaning method and now I am starting to realize how unnecessary it is. Don’t get me wrong, the product works, but there are cheaper alternatives for removing your makeup and cleaning your skin. I’m glad I tried this product but I don’t believe the price reflects the value of the product. I typically stick to higher end products but I don’t think a cleansing oil is necessary in a skincare routine.
product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser

review_text: I first purchased this back in March and at the time this did nothing for my dry skin during a cold ,dry winter. Now that it is extremely  humid where I live I figured I would give it another go. This quickly became my daytime moisturizer. It has a light gel like consistency that is almost watery until you work it into the skin. Another plus is how quickly it sinks into the skin. I think it’s a great moisturizer if you’re looking for something light that still gives enough moisture that last through the day.
product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: So,I just bought this from the original site, since I didn’t know it was on Sephora until literally right now! Anyways, just used it today and it is amazing already. No lie! I’ve been searching for months to find a good product for the price,size and cruelty free. So happy will try more products from the line. No weird smells or sticky feeling either.

I guess it works on some people, but it never did for me. I started breaking out even more after a week of use. The sephora lady told me it’s common at times to break out, but I should start seeing results soon. Two weeks came, no results noted. I was very disappointed because I paid $88+ tax for it. I had high hopes considering it is a top brand and there were many good reviews. I thought this will help my skin problem, but it actually just made it worst. I have ongoing breakouts right now. I never had this problem before. I usually just get one acne then it’ll be gone after few days. I normally get them on my period. But this time, it’s been very stubborn since I’ve been using this product.Maybe I’ll try Philosophy’s microdermabrasion. Again, I am so disappointed. I was hoping for at least some slight slight changes, but no. It made my skin breakout even more, and the redness from previous acne marks are still present. It didn’t lighten.Waste of money for my case. Won’t purchase again. I hope it’ll work out for you though (to the reader).
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: Wonderful product. Came seated and well packaged. Clean and clear with no perfume smell. Love it as a toner or to use cleaning my face. Generous size.
awesome cleanser, cleared my skin up so much. it is a little drying however so I do recommend using a moisturizer after using this

When I tried this for the first time I literally started jumping up and down because it was just the most satisfying makeup remover that I had EVER seen,I mean it completley melted my makeup making it so easy and satisfying to remove with a makeup wipe! I TOTALLY ADORE THIS PRODUCT!!!!!! (1 container lasts a long time)!! :)
product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

review_text: J’apprécie beaucoup ce nouveau gel hydratant! Il est léger sur la peau et n’est pas du tout collant. On ressent même l’effet un peu de picotement du sel aux endroits où la peau est très sèche.
product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer

review_text: Still can’t decide if I love it or not. You do see “dead skin” on your face coming off— but it’s hard to tell if it’s actually dead skin or just how the product is purposely formulated. Nonetheless, It smells nice and my skin looks good after using! Also very gentle.
product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub

review_text: Excellent product that can be used as lipstick while keeping your lips healthy. Every woman should have on in their purse!

Love this moisturizer! It’s thick and feels amazing on the skin. I put it on day and night and under makeup. If it’s really hot outside sometimes I’ll use a lighter moisturizer but I love this stuff. The air tight pump is great too, this lasted me 3 months using twice a day on average which helps justify the cost a little bit.

Loved these. Had a huge and painful pimple under my skin. Popped one on on my way to work and the next day it was almost completely better! I took a bunch to the office for my friends to try and no one has complained yet!

Got a sample of this and fell in love!  Now I have to buy it when I run out.  Wasn’t expecting to like this so much!  It’s very lightweight and smells good going on.  My skin is dry and this instantly makes my skin feel soooo soft and it looks glowy.  My skin texture looks even overall now and my pores even look a bit smaller.  Expensive but worth it! I’m officially addicted!!!!
I have normal to dry skin and this did nothing but make my face feel dry and tight. Not a fan.
Amazing. I purchased for my sister and had to buy her another bottle when she ran out. Completely changed her skin and receives so many compliments!

review_text: My skin is glowing after 1 use! I can only imagine what it will look like if I continue to use this product! Just beware to not use before being outside all day long your skin will Ben sensitive to sunlight.
product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel

review_text: Definitely unseen! Smoothing and matte, very nice product. Has a nice light scent.

Gorgeous texture, melts right into the skin, completely dissolves makeup even waterproof mascara and liner in an instant. It’s super gentle, emulsifies well, doesn’t leave a residue. However, do NOT get this into your eyes because it burns like crazy! It’s a shame because it works so well on eye makeup.

review_text: Pretty solid lip mask. It’s not too sticky and it hydrated my lips fairly well. I do feel like after drinking one sip of water that most of it is gone. I love the lipgloss type finish element. And I would rather wear it during the day than only specific at night. I like that it’s not too overpowering fragrance wise.

I love the way this serum feels so silky when I put it on. It is easily and quickly absorbed into the skin. I also like that it doesn’t have a strong fragrance. My skin feels soft, smooth, and hydrated after using this.
product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum

review_text: I love it. I have used Glow Recipe’s plum plump hyaluronic serum in the past and I loved it. This moisturizer made my skin feel the way. Soft, supple, and dewy. I loved this color and it looks beautiful on my vanity. Refillable jars are environment friendly. Favorite skincare product!
Need better packaging please.  3 stars for packaging, 5 stars for product   Product works great but difficult to get out of jar.  More under my mail than on my lips    A tube would be amazing
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Rarely do I give in to a product just because of the hype that surrounds it, but I’m so glad I did! This tube is a facial in a bottle. Not only does it make my skin glow and feel plumped and moisturized BUT ITS A CLEAN BEAUTY PRODUCT. Free from all of the harmful ingredients I stay away from.
Easy to use and smells good! I like the easy twist up part of the packaging. I personally like to rub it in once I apply, but the glide on stick is still really easy to use.
This product its super important in all my showers. It helps with all dead skin and take off all the oily zones!!

I received this for free but my expectations were pretty high because I have many products with this beauty line. First off I loved the scent, the lemon made me feel calm. I typically use a scrub once a week but this one was different with how it made my skin feel. My skin felt so smooth afterwards and clean. Would highly highly recommend!!

Serum in a stick? Sounds like convenience, and as a busy mama of 2, convenience is my thing. This serum is travel friendly; doesn’t take up much space in your makeup bag, and doesn’t require hand to face application. Aside from the brilliant packaging, the formulation of this Tatcha product lives up to the the brand’s credibility in quality skincare. I have been using this product daily (AM & PM) for a month before writing this review and I can attest that this serum has made an impact on my skin texture. It has also relieved random dry patches I tend to develop during the winter months by adding instant hydration. Although this serum is priced a bit higher in comparison to others, it delivers convenience and results, and don’t let the size fool you, a little bit goes a long way. Would recommend and repurchase.
product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm

review_text: I LOVE this product! Very smooth and smells great when cleaning my face, also gives it a tingly feel as well! I received this product as a free sample
product_name: Find Your Balance Oil Control Cleanser

It does a wonderful job at removing all types of makeup. I also find that you don’t have to rub your lashes too hard, as the product just eats away at it. review_text: Just finished the whole product! This feels really good on the skin and smells so good and feels luxurious to use. When it gets in my eyes it hurts for like an hour after. This was my first time using a balm, and I think I like using an oil based cleanser better because it doesn’t dry out my skin as much. I don’t think this dries out my skin a tonnn compared to other cleansers, but living in a really dry climate, my skin still feels tight after using this and want something more hydrating.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: I used this moisturizer right out of the shower. It’s light weight and has a nice light smell. It did create some breakouts and made my skin oily. I have combination skin but my forehead is extremely oily, so maybe not the best product for me or my skin type.

I have enjoyed it so far. It’s light, my skin soaks it in real quick and doesn’t make my face feel greasy which I was worried about and it’s improved the glow in my face. I will most likely to buy more once I run out.
product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo

review_text: This is great for people who get dry skin in the winter months. When used with a serum, I find it repairs my skin a whole lot better and fades dark spots easier. It’s expensive but the bottle can last for a long while. A little goes a long way.
Highly don’t recommend. It didn’t absorb and pilled off my skin. It also caused me to have cloudiness in my eyes.
product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid

review_text: I seldom feel compelled to write a review for any product but this is a game changer. Don’t even hesitate to purchase this item. It smells wonderful and it removes all makeup like a dream. If you are trying to decide if it is for you, rest assured it is AND it is clean! This is a buy that you will not/cannot even remotely regret.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: I’ve used this product for years. It removes every last stitch of every type of makeup and has never failed me in any way. (You can tell this review is going to be objective because that’s not overselling it.) I use a lot of waterproof “24/7“ makeup, all designed to stay put throughout my days filled with eye rubs, tissue pats, hard laughs, allergens, emotional outbursts, emotional inbursts, and various other forms of contact or wear--rendering most of makeups semi-permanent. Especially the eye stuff. Glitter liner, liquid liner, waterproof mascara, and so on. Just a few swipes with this stuff and it’s like it never happened! It feels oily and gross when rubbing it onto my face, which produces plenty of its own oils, and it took a while to get used to that. But it rinses away clean, NO residue. (Although I do use a soap afterwards for good housekeeping.) It lasts a good long time, too. If you bought this only for eye makeup, it would last you a ridiculously long time. (I use it for face and eyes and it lasts about 4 months.) I rub it all over my eye; the lid, the brow bone, underneath, and I gently rub it along the bottom lash line. It gets in my eye every time and makes my vision a little blurry until I rinse. NO stinging at all. (I have very sensitive eyes.) I’ve recommended this to everyone who complains about stubborn makeup and it’s a staple for me.
product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

review_text: I have been using this product for over a month now and it’s results are apparent! My skin is smooth and even and it didn’t make me break out! I use just a few drops on my face every night after I wash my face and a little goes a long way! There is no strong smells no it is perfect for my night routine! Overall, perfect!

This is my go to night cream. I even use it in the mornings before my typical pre-makeup moisturizer. I have combination skin so always hesitant to try thick creams. This one is great. A little goes a long way, and it doesn’t make me break out. It’s great in the winter and the summer. Love it!
product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

review_text: This is not the first time I have tried this product. I love a good Argan oil, and this definitely improved my skins hydration. My skin feels so smooth after applying this oil.

I received a free sample of Clarins Double Serum from Butterly . I tried it for 7 days , and I’m very impressed with this serum . I loved the way lathers on my skin and doesn’t leave a oily residue . My face feels and looks hydrated . I gave it only 4 star because the price .
product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate

review_text: My good old moisturizer. It does it’s job on its own or mixed with facial oils. It is a good staple.
product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

review_text: This is definitely in my top choices of moisturizers. As someone who has struggled with dry, sensitive, and acne prone skin... this is great on my skin. It’s not too heavy that it leaves it feeling oily and thick, but it still leaves my skin feeling very hydrated. Skin fix has been the best company to help my skin feel happy throughout my acne struggles. Thankful for their amazing products and ingredients.
product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

review_text: Great product! I was super impressed with how well this worked and will be purchasing in the future!
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: I tried the small bottle to see how my skin would like it and I have very sensitive skin. After trying it my skin felt so refreshed and clean. It did not irritate my skin at all and did not leave it dry after. I also like the feel of the glass bottle. I will definitely consider buying a larger one next time!
Unscented and gentle on my sensitive skin. Makes my makeup melt off and any residue washes off easily with a mild cleanser.
product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

review_text: If I could give this zero stars I would THIS IS NOT FOR SENSITIVE SKIN USERSThe second I did a spot test IT BURNED SO BAD I’m returning it ASAP.

No sticky residue. Love, love, love this for my dry skin.
product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: This really helps my big breakouts.Including it in my night time routine is a must!!

review_text: I was gifted this product by La Mer and I’m really glad that I had the chance to try it out. really loved this product but it may not be for everyone. review_title: A little goes a long way

product_name: Find Your Balance Oil Control Cleanser

review_text: Returned it. I could not get past the pungent odor (most likely from the papaya) and it had a bit of a stickier texture when layered on top of my serum. I used it for about 2 weeks straight morning and night and it unfortunately did nothing for my skin. If anything it made my pores more noticeable and my maskne flare up more.
product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya

review_text: I love everything about this sunscreen! The brand Glow Recipe has easily become one of my favourites, and this sunscreen did not disappoint! I’ve seen a few reviews regarding the sunscreen pilling under makeup. I haven’t had that issue, however I use this sunscreen as a moisturizer as well as I find my skin doesn’t need the extra moisture doing the summer.
Greatly unimpressed. Left my skin full. I have since heard good things about other first aid products but i have been apprehensive to try those products.

At first I wasn’t sure this product was going to work since I’ve heard mixed reviews. This product exfoliates your skin without being harsh. It will first lift all of the pimples from your face and then remove it. So you will see a negative affect at first but then after a week your skin will look flawless. It does hydrate your face so you don’t need to use a moisturizer. It does have a chemical smell to it but it doesn’t stay on your face. I cut the pads in half since it is expensive.
Great product. Only need a small amount so lasts forever

After being gifted the Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator.  I tested it out for 3 weeks and I think this product is perfect for all skin types. If you have sensitive skin the microfoliant won’t irritate your skin at all.  Most exfoliators with over exfoliate your skin this product does a great job of cleaning your face without stripping your face.

I absolutely love this exfoliator.!!!! I was thinking about buying the full size, but decided to purchase the mini size instead to see how my skin will react to it first. For the mini size the price is right, because it has enough for you to start seeing results. I started seeing result after using once a day for 6 days now. My skin is softer after each uses and my old acne blemishes started clearing up not completely, but getting to the point where I noticed my skin is glowing and a lighter complexion. I will continue to use this product with the Tatcha deep cleanse. Both works very well as a combination for acne skincare.

I bought this to avoid the white cast that some sunscreens have. This is transparent, odorless, and has a nice smooth application. It has silicone in it (Dimethicone), which I have no problem with other than it makes it a little prone to causing my makeup to pill. But it’s not terrible, and if you give it some dry-down time (.5 hr for me in a humid environment) it can help avoid that. I’d probably buy again.

absolutely in love with this product! during the winter months my face is very dry and my foundation always cracks. adding this to my moisturizer gives me the perfect glow that lasts. loving how sun kissed i look using it! no need to use foundation with this now since i’m fair and have freckles i don’t want to cover up.

review_title: This product is a lip saver!

The consistency is nice, almost like a very thin gel, and it has a very slight foam without being drying. I also like the glass/pump packaging. Definitely my new go to for cleanser.

love it!!! I had been looking for a sunscreen for my face that did not feel oily or looked white on my face like usual sun screens this one is light weight does not feel oily and it’s clear I wish they had a body sunscreen like this because its perfect.

YOU MUST TRY!

review_text: So... not only did the packaging change, but the whole wipe itself has changed! I’m not sure if I like it yet, but I loved the previous version especially the exfoliating side. This new design smells different and is a thicker material like a wash cloth. The exfoliating side is more gentle which some people may like.

One thing to note though, is It’s very difficult to spread on the other hand. It doesn’t seem to like to go into my skin, rather it sits on top. It takes a while to absorb. But no other complaints! Love the Apple lime lip mask. It works great after a sugar scrub to get the dead skin off. On the pricier side but it lasts a long time. Would recommend.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Recieved a ton of these samples from Sephora a few months ago. I let them sit because I had a ton of other moisturizers, but today I decided to use this after the 2 step Erno Vitamin Peel &my skin felt absolutely amazing afterwards!! Had a slight cooling effect, &what I loved the most was the gel-like consistency vs. just a regular lotion.

My life revolves around this moisturizer, and I’ve tried them all. I’m a huge Asian skincare person, and the only thing that comes close to this is Tatcha’s Indigo Cream. I don’t know if I believe in all of the hype, but I do know this formulation works well with my skin. I’ve also used Nivea Creme (directly imported from Germany) and the results are nowhere near the same, as Nivea leaves an oil slick, and this does not. My face is often tight, dehydrated, and combination oily... but if I use this cream, I am relatively great by the end of the day. (Which is a rarity in of itself.) 2) The first day I use it and several days after, I use a skin moisture & oil detector to see if my skin becomes excessively oily after use, (& I continue testing up to 12 hrs after) as well to see if my skin becomes too dry, or if it holds moisture and/or has more moisture then it normally does. After several tests, for several days, on both my skin & my fiancé’s (Because he is in love with this as well.) BOTH of our oil levels had decreased even throughout the day compared to what they normally are, but our moisture levels had significantly increased vs other cleansers used, and our baseline readings. This was the only product my fiancé used for the day, & the only product I changed in my normal skincare routine. 3) I look at how my skin feels after using up to the 24 hr mark. Did I have any dry patches? No. Did I feel oily? No. Did my skin feel more hydrated? Yes. Did my makeup apply easily after using? Yes. Did my skin seem more textured then usual? No. Blotchy? No. Reactions or redness? None. (I am super sensitive to skincare products, but my fiancé is super sensitive. A lot of products break him out on his chin. This one did not.) Tatcha...you put your foot in this one babes. Our faces have never felt so amazing. Thanks.

review_text:
I’m not even sure why I’m reviewing this because there’s already so much on Sunday Riley, and Good Genes especially. I have consistently super dry (not dehydrated), extremely sensitive skin which is beginning to show signs of aging (hi late twenties). While many reviews (here and elsewhere) claim there’s an overnight difference in their skin, I personally didn’t see that. However, I knew an overnight solution wasn’t possible with my dry, sensitive skin, and that only a prolonged regimen could permanently fix my skin.  We all know there’s no miracle in a jar in any market, but if you’re willing to add this to a regular routine it WILL gently exfoliate and help aging skin in the long term, and increase moisture levels in a shorter term. It’s a great chemical exfoliator, but any decent-quality chemical exfoliator should be doing those things for your skin anyway.

There are other products on the market that deliver similar results, and some of them are much more competitively priced. I know there’s a lot of mixed reviews out there, but I have EXTREMELY sensitive skin and The Ordinary’s 10% lactic acid + HA formula is a full-blown genuine FRACTION of Sunday Riley’s price, and I found the results with The Ordinary’s formula were a tad more effective, and were evident a lot sooner. Given the fact that Good Genes’ most cost-effective bottle (the 1.7oz one) just went up from $175 CAD to $200, and the fact that The Ordinary’s formula is $6.70 CAD per ounce, it’s hard to give Sunday Riley 5 stars instead of a well-deserved 4; SR’s formula’s definitely above-average, but there are other options of competitive and comparable quality, and there are other products with competitive (if not significantly cheaper) pricing, BUT when my skin is most sensitive and suffering dermatitis outbreaks, I always defer to Good Genes for chemical exfoliation, because the formula is one of the gentlest for its potency. That said, anyone looking for higher potency will know how to appropriately cycle their actives, and might not care about how gentle a formula is so long as it’s effective -- if that’s the case, Sunday Riley is sufficient but not the be-all-or-end-all it’s often characterized as.

I personally have a pretty well-rounded (read: extensive) skincare routine, with lots of targeted ingredients and specialized serums, so Good Genes serves primarily for chemical exfoliation. If you’re looking for an effective one-trick-pony, this might save you some money in the long run, but if you’ve got a K-beauty routine or a regimen of targeted skincare, Good Genes is a beautiful luxury I love to indulge in but, I’ve personally found, no more effective than less luxuriously priced products. I have tested this by switching from product to product, and even giving a month of downtime between using each active before comparing their results.
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: Firstly, I typically use a different brand of skincare religiously, but Influenster gave me three Origins GinZing products to try out for free. Currently I am using them exclusively, so that I can give a review for these themselves without interference to be completely fair. This scrub has lots of claims, from brightening your skin to waking your senses. It lives up to them, though, and the results are worth the hype. This scrub is the perfect consistency. It’s almost a thick gel cream, with of course the scrubby bits. At first, in your hand, it feels too gritty, and I was concerned about accidentally scratching my skin. No need to worry, because some of the grit dissolves, similarly to the Shea Moisture body scrubs. It becomes the PERFECT amount of grit, and you can feel it moisturizing as it cleanses. Blackheads? Gone. I noticed after two days, what blackheads I did have hanging out on my nose were completely gone. What my evening routine misses, this definitely makes up for in the morning. The scent is delicious, it actually makes me hungry. While not a claim of the product, it’s a bonus for me because I frequently forget breakfast and this revs my appetite. It’s very citrusy and fresh. Like a just cut grapefruit. As far as waking my senses, I would agree with that as well. Whether placebo or not, I do feel ready for the day when I wash it off and see the bright, clean face underneath. I certainly appear more awake, at the very least. I will continue to use this with my existing morning routine, I think this is a great compliment to the rest of my skincare, and it has so many great benefits that I honestly wasn’t sure a scrub could live up to. It’s gentle, it smells amazing, it brightens and smoothes my skin, and it really helps start my day on a positive note. Will be purchasing this one on my own when my complimentary product is all gone.

I asked Sephora reps about this claim on this product and they have had classes and workshops on this and they’re skepticism about this product was quickly erradicated when they learned about the product. I was taking antibiotics for a bit but stopped and just decided to be super intentional and careful about my skincare.SO. I have been using this product for about 4 weeks now, first the first 2 just once a week, and now, twice a week. And honestly....I understand the hype around retinol. I have seen significant changes in my skin with the acne around my cheeks and jawline really minimizing quite quickly, and the minimal acne scarring I have around my forehead has also blurred quite a bit. I’m hoping that with continued use the acne scarring where I had more persistent hormonal acne around my cheeks will start to go away!I did not experience anything like dry skin or a lot of tightness but I have been diligent about following the directions on the bottle, mixing it with the B-Hydra and using a moisturizer with hyaluronic acid to maximize moisturization. As well, my skin always feels super soft the morning after I use! Overall as a beginner retinol user I am super satisfied and impressed with this product, and will most likely be repurchasing once I run out - but because I am using it only twice a week currently and only a pea sized amount the mini bottle should last me quite a while!

Omg, I’ve NEVER used any skincare that caused such a change in my skin, as quickly or as effectively. I always took beauty/skin product claims with a grain of salt because I never saw any changes they promised without using religiously for 4-6 months and even then it was only a fraction of what was claimed. Well, I will never be without Good Genes. I bought it in a set with Luna oil and both are amazing. Good Genes gets right down to tackling slow skin cell turnover rate and by the first few days I could see a fresher look to my skin, like that dead layer that wants to cling so badly was being shed. From the get-go it was healing a few pimples I had  (I’m 43 and take Retin-A for stubborn persistent acne and although it Retin-A has gotten me so far, it isn’t the be-all, end-all, and my skin became so dry, it looked reptilian). I noticed that freckles and old pimple hyperpigmentation I had and I was treating with another product for 6 months were getting even lighter after just a couple weeks with Good Genes. This is not just another lactic acid, this is a treatment product that is your brightener, exfoliator, your skintone-evener, skin-plumper and hydrator (lactic acid is a humectant and draws in moisture). I will never be without this miracle worker. :)

review_text: When I first used this product I had ordered a sample size of three products, this was one of them. The only thing that concerned me was the vitamin C that the product contained. So far it has behaved itself and is dealing well with the C. In the past I have used some other oils and I did not like them at all, they made me feel like my face had been dipped in a vat of oil, it would never absorb into my skin, it would just sit on the top and feel icky and sticky. So I had a hesitation there as well. I should not have been worried, this oil is wonderful. It only takes 4-5 drops to cover my entire face and within minutes it is absorbed and my skin feels so good, no oily residue no sticky and no tacky, just silky smooth. It took me using it a few times to figure out just how little I needed to use. The next morning after using this I wake up to the softest skin I have ever had in the last 10 years. During this year I have tried a lot of new products of varying types but this, by far, has been the most impressive I have tried. The only hesitation for me was the cost. It is definitely pricey but as little as this takes to cover my face it will last for months so I feel like I will most definitely get my money’s worth from the product. It took me a while to convince myself to purchase the full size, I argued with myself for months until I finally made the leap and I am glad I did. If you have mature skin that is sensitive and irritable I can actually say give it a try if you can, if it works as well for you as it has me you will not regret your decision to buy. As an aside, this is, I believe one of the few products I have ever given 5 stars to.
